places.title: Home
places.purpose: Intranet landing page. After Microsoft Entra sign-in it shows four application cards: Chat, Lead, Sales, and Feature Requests. Unsigned visitors only see Sign in with Microsoft.
commonQuestions: How do I get back to applications?
What apps are on the intranet?
places.fallbackAnswer: Home is the intranet landing page. After you sign in with Microsoft you will see Chat, Lead, Sales, and Feature Requests. The ETC logo in the header always returns here.

places.title: Chat
places.purpose: Company ChatGPT / knowledge-base RAG. Create a project, start a chat, upload files, and save prompts. Answers use project documents. Local Ollama is used when the GPU VM is up; otherwise a hosted OpenAI-compatible model when KnowledgeBase Fallback is configured. This is not the floating Help panel.
commonQuestions: Where do I go to create a chat?
How do I start a new chat?
How do I upload documents to the knowledge base?
places.fallbackAnswer: Open Chat from Home (the ChatGPT / knowledge-base card). Create a project with New project if you do not have one, then click New chat. Use Files to upload documents and Prompts to save reusable instructions. Chat is for company documents and Q&A — not this Help guide.

places.title: Lead
places.purpose: Multifamily lead-based paint (LBP) inspection workspace. Look up a job, import XRF workbooks from SharePoint (XRF-SourceFiles library / Lead Inspection Upload web part), review the grid, normalize readings, and generate reports.
commonQuestions: How do I open a job?
Where do I import XRF readings?
How does SharePoint import work for Lead?
places.fallbackAnswer: Lead is the multifamily LBP workspace. From Home open Lead, enter a job number, then import XRF files from SharePoint, review the grid, normalize, and generate reports.

places.title: Sales
places.purpose: Sales hub. Choose Bids (CLEATUS government opportunities) or Pipeline (pursuits and close-outs). This page does not list bids itself.
commonQuestions: How do I get to Bids or Pipeline?
places.fallbackAnswer: Sales is the hub for Bids and Pipeline. From Home open the Sales card, then choose Bids (CLEATUS opportunities) or Pipeline (pursuits and close-out). Feature Requests is a separate Home card, with a shortcut from Sales.

places.title: Bids
places.purpose: Recommended government bids from CLEATUS. This is the opportunity list, not the pursuit board. Filter by search, deadline, NAICS, and set-aside. Default minimum recommendation score is 80. When ETC decides to pursue a bid, it is tracked on Pipeline.
commonQuestions: How do I find government opportunities?
places.fallbackAnswer: Bids live under Sales. From Home open Sales, then the Bids card. That page lists recommended CLEATUS government opportunities. It is not Pipeline — Pipeline tracks deals ETC is already pursuing.

places.title: Pipeline
places.purpose: Pursuits ETC is already working. Phases are triage, preparing, submitted, won, lost, and archived. Close-out records why a pursuit was won, lost, or dropped. Needs close-out highlights overdue items. This is not the Bids opportunity list.
commonQuestions: What do triage, preparing, and submitted mean?
places.fallbackAnswer: Pipeline is the pursuit board: jobs ETC is already working, with phases triage / preparing / submitted / won / lost / archived, plus close-out. It is not Bids, which lists new CLEATUS opportunities. Open Sales first if you are not sure which you need.

places.title: Feature Requests
places.purpose: Queue of intranet improvement ideas stored in Postgres. New notes can be structured by an optional local model; they still save if that model is down. Reviewers mark a row new → planned → done. Planned means it was picked up. Done means the work finished. New is the default just after capture. Areas include Chat, Lead, Sales, General, and Other.
commonQuestions: How do I request a feature?
How do I submit a feature request?
What do new, planned, and done mean?
How do I mark a request planned or done?
places.fallbackAnswer: Open the Feature Requests card on Home (or Requests from Sales). Use Add feature request, pick Chat / Lead / Sales / General / Other, and write a note. The queue statuses are new (just captured), planned (picked up), and done (finished). Change status on a row in that same page.

places.title: Help
places.purpose: Short in-app guide for finding intranet apps. It answers from an AI model grounded only on this curated map (Ollama when healthy, else the same hosted KnowledgeBase Fallback chat as company Chat), or from map scoring when no model is available. It does not search Chat documents and is not company ChatGPT.
commonQuestions: Is Help the same as Chat?
places.fallbackAnswer: Help is this side panel (the floating Help button), not Chat. It only knows the intranet map: Home, Chat, Lead, Sales, Bids, Pipeline, Feature Requests, and sign-in. Chat is the knowledge-base ChatGPT under the Chat card on Home.

places.title: Sign in
places.purpose: Gates every intranet app. Use your Microsoft work account (Entra ID / Azure AD). The Help button appears only after sign-in. API calls use the same Entra access token.
commonQuestions: How does Microsoft Entra sign-in work?
Where is Sign in with Microsoft?
places.fallbackAnswer: Sign in on Home with Sign in with Microsoft (Entra ID / your work account). After the redirect you land on Home or a saved deep link such as a Lead job. The Help button and application cards appear only once you are signed in.
